paragraphs.source_en: After Tsurumatsu's death, there was much discussion over who should become the Toyotomi heir. Toyotomi Hideyoshi had adopted Hidenobu, a son of Oda Nobunaga; but just as Hidenobu had risen to the Senior Third Rank and Provisional Middle Counselor and become lord of Kameyama Castle in Tanba, he died of illness. Tatsuhime, Chacha's younger sister who had married Hidenobu, had since remarried. Everyone therefore believed that Hideyoshi's nephew Hashiba Hidetsugu, the son of his elder sister, should now be named heir.
